values.note: Operator: daily $40, weekly $175, monthly $450 plus electricity, seasonal rates on request; $10 per additional vehicle, $10 per extra tent. The rates page carries no date (same figures read 2026-10-16). Read 2026-11-16.

values.note: By phone or the website's reservation request form; payment by check or PayPal.

note: Family-run park in the pines on the Wisconsin River ~1.5 mi south of Land O' Lakes on US-45, near the Michigan line; bathhouse, fish-cleaning house, pavilion, and trails into 600 acres of woods. Seasonal campers hold part of the park alongside nightly guests; the split isn't posted. --Claude
summary: Operator pages confirm $40 daily (weekly/monthly/seasonal too, page undated), May 1-Oct 31, full hookups, pull-throughs, wifi, laundry, phone/form booking; operator site map shows 38 sites (was 30). Nightly share not measurable; Google 4.6 (47) with recent weekend and seasonal reviews. Not waterfront kept. Pin is on US-45: small move (~125 m) to the sites.
flags: LONG-STAY check (private): mixed nightly/seasonal. Operator posts 'Daily $40 | Weekly $175 | Monthly $450 plus electricity | Seasonal rates available', its rules address 'Tenants' and forbid 'subleasing of units by tenants', and the site map labels a 'Seasonal Clubhouse'. No wording discourages nightly guests. The nightly share could not be measured (no per-site breakdown; leaf-on imagery too blurry to count set-up units). Google Maps 4.6 (47 reviews): recent ones include 'every weekend for 6 weeks' (2 yrs ago), 'a pleasant weekend' (3 yrs) and 'We have a seasonal site' (2 yrs); review topics list 'seasonal site' x2. Passes presence + price (website, phone, posted daily rate, RV Life $$). Reviewer: not a clear drop candidate, but rates page is undated (site copyright 2017; same text read 2026-10-16).
Price gate: $40 base, under $50; Good Sam false.
Electric 50 (derived) left: no amperage on the operator pages.
Waterfront not waterfront kept: the river (~25 m wide here, creek-size) runs north of the park behind continuous pine woods; no site is within ~50 m over open ground on Esri imagery.
Pin: stored 46.1402,-89.2057 sits on US-45 by the river bridge; the sites centre ~46.1398,-89.2042 (Google place 46.13957,-89.20460 at the office), ~125 m east. Under 250 m but on the highway.
Phone 715-547-6169 and website https://borderlinervpark.com/ confirmed. Facebook page not read.
Showers / flush toilets not stated in words (only 'Bath House').
